name: Soft International Group Ltd.
summary: Soft International Group Ltd., founded in 2010 and headquartered in Quanzhou, is an investment holding company making and distributing disposable sanitary goods and non-woven fabrics in China, Russia, Southeast Asia, Kazakhstan and elsewhere. Its two divisions are contract manufacturing, where it acts as ODM for baby products under Insoftb, and a branded business covering feminine hygiene under Misecr and adult incontinence under Cosoftb, sold through online channels.
